ops-bridge.description: Self-hosted ops bridge: a bash-launched MCP server that runs shell commands for the agent, reachable over the network.

local-terminal.description: Local stdio terminal server. Shell-capable, but stdio-only, so it is not reachable over the network.

docs-remote.description: Remote read-only docs server. Unauthenticated and network-reachable, but it grants no execution capability.

authed-bridge.description: Authenticated remote exec bridge. Shell-capable and network-reachable, but it requires a bearer token.
